mapper.sql: select f.record_id, f.record_no, f.user_id, f.dept_id, f.project_id, f.task_id, f.category_id, f.record_type, f.amount, f.tax_amount, f.currency, f.record_date, f.pay_method, f.settle_status, f.settled_amount, f.trade_no, f.counterparty, f.invoice_no, f.voucher_url, f.source, f.del_flag, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, f.remark, p.project_name as projectName, c.category_name as categoryName, coalesce(u.nick_name, wu.nick_name, u.user_name) as userName from biz_finance_record f left join biz_project p on p.project_id = f.project_id and p.del_flag = '0' left join biz_finance_category c on c.category_id = f.category_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user u on u.user_id = f.user_id left join biz_wx_user wu on wu.wx_user_id = f.user_id and wu.del_flag = '0'

select p.project_id as projectId, p.project_name as projectName, p.status as status, p.customer_name as customerName, p.budget_amount as budgetAmount, p.hour_rate as hourRate, ifnull(f.income_total, 0) as incomeTotal, ifnull(f.cost_total, 0) as costTotal, ifnull(f.settled_income, 0) as settledIncome, ifnull(w.hours, 0) as workHours, ifnull(w.billable_hours, 0) as billableHours from biz_project p left join ( select project_id, sum(case when record_type = '0' then amount else 0 end) as income_total, sum(case when record_type = '1' then amount else 0 end) as cost_total, sum(case when record_type = '0' then settled_amount else 0 end) as settled_income from biz_finance_record where del_flag = '0' and project_id is not null group by project_id ) f on f.project_id = p.project_id left join ( select project_id, round(sum(duration) / 3600, 2) as hours, round(sum(case when billable = '0' then duration else 0 end) / 3600, 2) as billable_hours from biz_work_log where del_flag = '0' and log_status = '1' and project_id is not null group by project_id ) w on w.project_id = p.project_id
